name: job-search-autopilot
description: Personal job-search app: sources and scores jobs, prepares applications, and keeps a human in the loop before anything is submitted.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p extension
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
